info.title: ScholarMatch API
info.description: Scholarship matching for VA / NC / SC students. Local use only (no authentication).

schema.title: Response Catalog Stats Api Catalog Stats Get
Response List Profiles Api Profiles Get

put.description: Create or replace a profile. Essays already on file are kept (manage them with the essay endpoints).

delete.description: Erase the profile, saved scholarships, match history and chats from this computer.

post.description:
Add .txt / .pdf essays. Each one's text is sent to the AI once, with the student's name, county, city and
high school removed, to pull out themes. Problems with single files come back as `warnings`.

Start a match run in the background (or return the one already running for this profile). If the profile,
catalog and settings are unchanged since today's stored run, that run is reused and the job finishes at once
(unless `force`).

get.description:
Server-sent events: one `progress` event per change, then a final `done` or `error` event. Each event's
data is the Job as JSON.

parameters.name: hide_unverified

get.description: Every Supervisor accept / reject decision for one run (the "Data & audit" page).

put.description:
Save a scholarship or change its status / note. A new save keeps a snapshot of the latest match result
(or of the catalog row if it is not in the latest run).

ProfileIn.title: ProfileIn
ProfileIn.description:
Every editable profile field except essays, which have their own endpoints. Unset fields take the defaults
of `StudentProfile`. `state` is a two-letter code; use "XX" for a state outside VA / NC / SC.
